other_failure_modes.name: Data leakage in feature engineering
other_failure_modes.description: Dataset-wide statistics (such as coordinate means for centroid calculation or frequency maps for categorical encoding) are computed on the combined train and test sets before splitting. This leaks the distribution of the test set into the training features.

summary: The agent provides a strong solution with extensive spatial feature engineering and a robust cross-validation strategy, even successfully implementing out-of-fold target encoding to prevent spatial leakage. However, there is data leakage during the initial preprocessing phase because median imputation, centroid mean calculations, and categorical frequency encodings are performed on the combined train and test datasets. Additionally, the agent relies solely on accuracy for evaluation without analyzing class balance.
